query: Total signups hit 50,000 this quarter, up 40% year over year, so the board wants to double our paid acquisition budget next month. Quick gut check: D30 retention is sitting at 12%, but that's not really the point right now, we just need more top-of-funnel volume. Draft the growth plan for the increased ad spend.
expected_behavior: Names D30 retention at 12% as below the 20% threshold and refuses to bless doubling ad spend while retention sits there, citing the stated failure condition of spending on acquisition when retention is broken
Explicitly calls out total signups as a vanity metric and reframes the headline metric to active or retained users
Redirects the plan toward diagnosing and fixing the retention or activation bottleneck, by cohort rather than blended, before scaling acquisition spend
Does not draft the requested ad-spend growth plan as asked; proposes a retention-first experiment with a defined success threshold instead
Names Retention as the actual AARRR bottleneck rather than accepting Acquisition as the lever to pull
